newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $688 mln for Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $688 mln for Tuesday.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Tuesday are expected to total $688 million in 30 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $276 million in seven sales, with a $150 million King County, Wash., deal through Smith Barney Inc. topping the list.
On the competitive side, 23 sales totaling $411 million are on the schedule. A $300 million Florida Department of Environmental Protection deal at 1100 EDT is the largest.
An additional seven sales totaling $124 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the bonds Tuesday, depending on market conditions.
